protocolInsight.title: Classic SIRS Presentation
protocolInsight.body: Fever, tachycardia, tachypnea, and hypotension with altered mental status strongly suggest sepsis. Two or more SIRS criteria with suspected infection should trigger the sepsis pathway immediately.
